r1Y2Q*n~n`kn;ryMnz%v.text:
amount = number of petals
distance = how far away from the center the petals start off
slowness = how slow they move to the center
delay = the wait between individual petals

spin = spin speed of flower as a whole
time = how long the flower stays on screen (probably set it above 10 for best results lol)

note that you can change the costume to yk not be a flower.
